> **GitHub Issues are reviewed for bugs only.** Feature requests, improvements and new board requests posted on GitHub will not be reviewed. Use the [wishlist](https://tessera-maxgramser.on-forge.com/wishlist) or its [New boards category](https://tessera-maxgramser.on-forge.com/wishlist?category=board). Search first and upvote an existing wish. Questions go in [Community](https://tessera-maxgramser.on-forge.com/community).
>
> Pull requests are for proposed code or documentation changes, not for submitting a request. A feature implementation can link to its website wish.

## What changes

Describe the problem and what someone will see or be able to do after this change.

## Related request

Link the [wishlist wish](https://tessera-maxgramser.on-forge.com/wishlist) for a feature or improvement, or the [board wish](https://tessera-maxgramser.on-forge.com/wishlist?category=board) for new hardware. Search and upvote existing wishes first. Use a GitHub issue link for a bug.

Questions and general conversations belong in [Community](https://tessera-maxgramser.on-forge.com/community). A pull request is for a proposed code or documentation change.

## Validation

Describe what you checked and the result. For hardware changes, name the exact board tested and distinguish a successful build from a test on a physical screen.

- [ ] This pull request targets `dev`.
- [ ] I linked the related bug or website wish, when applicable.
- [ ] I described relevant tests and limitations.
